scenario: A federal grants compliance officer at a university reviews a quarterly expenditure register submitted by a principal investigator, applies 2 CFR 200 cost allowability principles to each cost category, and produces an official cost allowability determination letter for the sponsoring federal agency.
info_flow: csv-pipeline parses the expenditure register CSV and groups cost line items by category, producing a category-level summary with total amounts and item counts → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates each cost category against federal cost allowability requirements and assigns a determination → reporting formats the determinations into a structured cost allowability letter for the federal sponsor.
